how-does-it-work.title: Waxpeer – a P2P  marketplace of virtual items

content.p1: Selling is easy, yet there are a few things that must be set in order to be able to sell. Firstly, you must save your trade link and your Steam API key in ‘Steam Account’ section of your WaxPeer user profile.
content.p2: WaxPeer is a worldwide CS:GO and DOTA 2 marketplace depending on Player-to-Player (P2P) system. Anyone can freely deposit to WaxPeer to purchase skins from other players and anyone can sell their skins to other players and withdraw their money.
